## `src/Contracts/OrderPriority.cs`

### `OrderPriority`

POST 38: Processing priority for an order. Null (absent in old messages) is treated as Normal by consumers.

## `src/OrderService/BusinessMetrics.cs`

### `BusinessMetrics`

Business-domain OTel metrics for the order pipeline. POST 35: These metrics fill the observability gap — domain values not captured by infrastructure instrumentation (spans, queue depth, etc.).

## `src/OrderService/FallbackServiceBusSender.cs`

### `SendOrderAsync`

POST 37: Send an order message using primary queue, falling back to secondary. Returns the route taken ("primary" or "fallback") for OTel span tagging.

## `src/ServiceDefaults/TelemetryConstants.cs`

### `TelemetryConstants`

Custom business attribute names for this system's telemetry schema. See docs/telemetry-schema.md for the full attribute contract.

### `AttrUserId`

The authenticated user's internal identifier.

### `AttrIpAddress`

The client IP address for the request.

### `AttrEndUserRole`

The user's role within the system.

### `AttrTenantId`

The tenant identifier. Required on all multi-tenant records. Used as Service Bus message property for subscription routing. KQL invariant: no order record may lack this attribute.

### `AttrOrderId`

The order's unique identifier.

### `AttrEventType`

The domain event type for event-sourcing records.

### `AttrElapsedMs`

Elapsed time in milliseconds — for slow-operation warnings.

### `MetricOrderValueUsd`

Histogram: dollar value of each order. Unit: USD. Instrument type: Histogram<double>. KQL: OTelMetrics | where MetricName == TelemetryConstants.MetricOrderValueUsd

### `MetricTenantOrderCount`

Counter: total orders created per tenant. Instrument type: Counter<long>. KQL: OTelMetrics | where MetricName == TelemetryConstants.MetricTenantOrderCount

### `MeterOrdersBusiness`

Meter name for the business metrics group. Register with AddMeter(TelemetryConstants.MeterOrdersBusiness) in ServiceDefaults.

## `src/ServiceDefaults/TraceContextPropagator.cs`

### `InjectTraceContext`

POST 39: Call this BEFORE sending a ServiceBusMessage. Injects the current Activity's trace context into ApplicationProperties so the consumer can reconstruct the parent-child span relationship.

### `ExtractTraceContext`

POST 39: Call this when starting an Activity for a RECEIVED message. Parses the traceparent from ApplicationProperties and returns an ActivityContext that StartActivity can use as the parent — this is what links the consumer span to the producer's trace.
